title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Automatically create Lot/Serial No. Information card on posting (No customization)
summary: Dynamics 365 Business Central can automatically create Lot and Serial Number Information cards during purchase order posting without customization. This feature uses Item Tracking Code options to generate missing cards when inbound transactions are posted, simplifying item tracking workflows for companies that need to track items from entry.
key_points: Item Tracking Code has two standard options: Create SN Info. on posting and Create Lot No. Info. on posting
Serial or lot numbers can be assigned automatically using predefined number series or custom number series, or manually by entering vendor numbers
Information cards are automatically created during document posting if they don't already exist
No customization required; this functionality is available as a standard feature
features: Automatic Lot No. Information card creation
Automatic Serial No. Information card creation

quotes.text: After the purchase order is posted, the Lot No. Information Card has been automatically created.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the end result of the feature in action
